description: This bar chart illustrates performance metrics for several question answering models across different datasets and evaluation methods. The horizontal axis displays the model and dataset combinations, labeled as “TriviaQA (EM)”, “HotPotQA (EM)”, “2Wiki (EM)”, “TriviaQA (F1)”, “HotPotQA (F1)”, and “2Wiki (F1)”, presented in an unspecified order. The vertical axis, labeled “Score”, represents a linear scale ranging from 25 to 85, with tick marks at intervals of 10.  Four bars are present for each model/dataset combination, colored light blue, red, yellow, and dark blue. The light blue bars range in height from approximately 31.9 to 82.8, with the “TriviaQA (EM)” bar at 77.3 and the “2Wiki (EM)” bar at 32.5. The red bars range from approximately 37.0 to 49.7, with the “TriviaQA (EM)” bar at 44.5 and the “HotPotQA (F1)” bar at 43.3. The yellow bars range from approximately 38.1 to 53.3, with the “2Wiki (F1)” bar at 38.1 and the “HotPotQA (EM)” bar at 53.3. The dark blue bars range from approximately 77.1 to 83.8, with the “TriviaQA (EM)” bar at 83.8 and the “HotPotQA (EM)” bar at 77.1. No bars are visually emphasized, and the chart does not include a legend to explain the meaning of the different colors.
